name: Default
shortDescription: Pterodactyl Panel, the web interface for managing game servers that run in isolated Docker containers on Wings nodes.

alerts.message: No account exists after the first start. Open a terminal in the pterodactyl container and run php artisan p:user:make to create the first administrator.

This template deploys only the Panel. Game servers run on Wings, which must be installed separately on a host with Docker and linked to the Panel as a node. Because the Panel is served over HTTPS, Wings needs its own TLS certificate for its FQDN.
